sources.snippet: Cosmos3 LIBERO40-only Full-FT baseline, GBS2048, 4k Public re-release of the no-OOD-video baseline at step4000, not an OOD-trained, filtered, human-selected or nested policy. Full fine-tuning from Cosmos3-Nano on original LIBERO40 demonstrations: Spatial,Object,Goal,LIBERO-10,50 episodes/task before the native1% validation split. Joint video+action supervision; no added OOD data.
